name: Occupancy-Based Dual Contouring
definition: A dual contouring method for converting occupancy functions to meshes that modifies the computation of grid edge points (1D points) and grid cell points (3D points) to not use distance information, instead using auxiliary 2D points to compute local surface normals.
summary: Occupancy-Based Dual Contouring extracts high-fidelity meshes from neural occupancy functions without gradients by using auxiliary 2D points for normals and resolving topological ambiguities.
